title: GE MDS PulseNET FileServlet Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of GE MDS PulseNET. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the FileServlet servlet. When parsing the name parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information under the context of the current service.
